articles.title: Crypto exchange Luno cuts 20% of staff amid automation push and retail trading slumps
articles.snippet: The DCG-owned company previously cut 35% of staff in January 2023 citing tough market conditions.

articles.title: Bitcoin and ether markets are ruled by perps. SpaceX showed how far their influence can go
articles.snippet: Perpetual futures drive much of the price discovery for bitcoin and ether. When traders pointed the same machinery at a private company, they priced the biggest IPO in history more accurately than Wall Street, and then watched the stock walk away from them.

articles.title: As crypto perpetual futures boom, Ethereum’s role is shifting
articles.snippet: Rather than competing directly with faster chains, some builders argue Ethereum's strength lies in supporting the layer-2 networks where trading is taking place.

articles.title: Chinese newspaper warns of Bitcoin extortion scam using its name
articles.snippet: China Business Journal says fraudsters impersonated the publication, demanding Bitcoin to suppress purported investigative reports about targeted companies.

articles.title: Luno cuts 20% of staff as crypto layoffs spread across 12 firms in July
articles.snippet: Luno and Gnosis joined a widening round of crypto restructurings in July, when at least 12 companies reported job cuts.
